findings.evidence: `n.get("shape", "rectangle")` passes an unchecked shape directly to node(). Following `new` with {"nodes":[{"label":"DB","shape":"hexagon"}]} constructs an element with type `hexagon`; check() only requires a nonempty element type, so write() reports success. A subsequent summary omits that node because its type is outside SHAPES. The validation gate therefore permits an unsupported element instead of rejecting the spec.
findings.fix: Validate each node's shape against SHAPES before constructing elements. Raise SceneError with the supplied value and supported choices, leaving OUT unwritten. Add a regression test asserting that an unsupported shape returns a clear error and creates no output file.
